question: On what causal ground are the three realities declared to be so named?
premises: A causal ground is stated in fused form.
The three realities are the items named.
They are declared by quotative attribution.
inference: On the ground of being a cause of illuminating reality, the three realities are so declared.
uncertainties: Which three realities are intended is not specified by this verse alone
plain_english: Because it causes the illumination of reality, the three realities are so declared.
